CustomField.formula:
IF( TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Failed__c, 'Error',
IF( TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Processed__c,
IF(TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Company_Match__c,'Company' & IF( TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Contact_Match__c || TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Lead_Match__c || TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Custom_Match__c,' and ',''),'') &
IF(TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Contact_Match__c, 'Contact' & IF( TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Lead_Match__c || TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Custom_Match__c,' and ',''),'') &
IF(TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Custom_Match__c, 'Custom' & IF( TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Lead_Match__c,' and ',''),'') &
IF(TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Lead_Match__c, 'Lead','') &
IF(!TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Company_Match__c && !TracRTC__Realtime_Clean_Contact_Match__c && !TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Lead_Match__c && !TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Custom_Match__c,'No', '')
& ' Match','Not Processed' ) & IF(TracRTC__Traction_Complete_Paused__c, ' - Paused', '') )
CustomField.label: Traction Complete Status Text
